payload.purpose_context: Directives carry an enforcement level and prose about how binding they are, and the two disagree (#233). How strictly a directive binds is a property of the adopting project's charter. This mission defines required, lenient-adherence and advisory once in the foundation glossary and the pack-authoring guidance, removes self-binding prose from directive bodies and the software-dev plan/implement/review content, and keeps the enforcement field as a pack-supplied default because the pinned charter schema requires it.
payload.purpose_tldr: Define the directive enforcement levels once and take enforcement and criticality prose out of every pack's content.

options: A: statements about how strictly the directive itself binds (level, criticality, v1 gate posture); keep descriptions of concrete checks a procedure or tool performs
B: also every MUST/mandatory/required word in rule text
payload.question: Which directive-body prose counts as enforcement/criticality prose to remove?

options: A: keep every current default value unchanged; only the prose moves
B: re-level 028 to advisory and review the others
